scope: Prepare a completed external Agent result as a new separately authorized sibling delegation under the same Zema parent job
implementation: Only results whose task is completed and whose text artifact capture is recorded may be used.
Non-text omissions, truncated documents, malformed parts and prompts over 8,000 characters are rejected.
The source Agent identity and artifact are serialized as JSON untrusted data with explicit no-instruction/no-authority/no-permission-transfer language.
The UI action prefills a new draft, clears the previous target, quote and prompt-sharing consent, and reuses the existing parent budget currency/cap. It does not send the next task.
The next task remains a direct sibling under the same parent, so existing child count/concurrency and shared atomic budget constraints apply; recursive Agent re-delegation remains disabled.
